title: Unprecedented crisis grips US colleges, squeezed by soaring costs and Trump-fuelled distrust

title: Mafias in Corsica use arson to tighten grip on local economy
subhead: Hotels, restaurants and businesses have increasingly become targets of deliberate destruction, such as the fire that gutted a beach bar overnight between August 10 and 11 in Ajaccio.
